messages:
mira-sales: Quick alert 01 NimbusCare POC is getting 429s during their end-to-end demo. They say its intermittent and sometimes the response has no Retry-After. Demo in 2h.
devin-support: Can you paste one of the raw responses and confirm the exact endpoint and concurrency theyre using?
mira-sales: They hit /v1/completions and /v1/embeddings concurrently from a Node stress harness, ~30 concurrent workers. Sample 429 (redacted):\n```json\n{\n  "error": "rate_limit_exceeded",\n  "code": "per_tenant_token_budget",\n  "route": "/v1/completions",\n  "message": "Token budget temporarily exceeded",\n  "request_id": "nc-44f"\n}\n```\n
noel-eng: Interesting  code indicates tenant token budget enforcement (not per-route burst). But they said monthly usage low? Could be short-term token accounting spikes from many concurrent completions+embeddings. Also some clients fire small requests that cause token rounding inefficiencies.
june-oncall: I can pull the tenant live accounting. Give me 2m.
billing-bot: Tenant usage snapshot: tenant=nimbuscare, month_commit=500k, month_used=42k (8.4%), current_inflight_token_estimate=12.3k, token_pool_remaining=487.7k.
noel-eng: That snapshot confirms monthly budget fine. The 429 implies a short-lived token credit cap or a rate-limiter on token burn rate. Check their average tokens per request in the harness.
devin-support: I asked them for sample request/response sizes. They sent: avg_request_tokens=120, avg_response_tokens=80, embedding_calls ~40 tokens each. With 30 concurrent workers thats ~6k tokens/sec instantaneous peak which could trip a token burn-rate guard.
mira-sales: Theyre nervous because sometimes response doesn't include Retry-After. Partial demo logs attached (redacted): lots of 429 lines with no retry header.
noel-eng: Two immediate actions: 1) temporary presales token-burn rate increase for 2h (raise short-term token throughput cap), 2) recommend client reduce concurrency or batch requests. If Retry-After missing, clients must still implement exponential backoff.
june-oncall: I can apply a short-term throughput allowance: +100k tokens/sec burst for 2 hours for tenant=nimbuscare. Need approval from sales.
mira-sales: Approve the temporary lift. Marked as emergency presales assist.
billing-bot: Token throughput change request queued: tenant=nimbuscare, delta_burst_tokens=100000, duration=7200s, id=TB-185550-14.
billing-bot: Change applied. Expires at 1855517076.
noel-eng: Also share this quick checklist to NimbusCare:
- Reduce max_concurrency to 10 for demo.
- Reuse keep-alive HTTP connections.
- For completions: prefer streaming responses when >200 tokens expected.
- Implement backoff: if Retry-After present, sleep that many seconds + jitter; otherwise apply exponential backoff with full jitter (base=0.5s, cap=30s).
- Consider aggregating small embedding requests into batch calls.
devin-support: Noted. I'll send a short troubleshooting note and the above steps. Also asking them to forward exact harness timings so we can correlate with SLO graphs.
mira-sales: They're re-running the harness now with the temporary lift. Will update in 15.

june-oncall: Monitoring dashboards: after change, 0 429s for the last 5 minutes and token burn spiked but within temporary allowance.

mira-sales: Demo completed successfully  they said the UI was smooth. Following up to recommend longer-term presales quota if they plan sustained load.
noel-eng: Long-term fix options to propose: increase sustained token throughput for paid tiers, pre-warm token credits for demos, or design client-side batching + streaming to reduce per-request token spikes.
mira-sales: Thanks team  will file a presales quota request and attach the troubleshooting notes to the deal. Closing thread unless anyone needs to add more.
